summary_short: Elanco's Q1 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,371M (+14.9% y/y, +19.8% q/q) on higher Pet Health and Farm Animal volumes and pricing, but net income fell to $57M (-14.9% y/y, diluted EPS $0.11) as interest expense jumped 43% and the effective tax rate swung to 34.6% from a prior-year benefit.
summary_long: Revenue grew across both segments: Pet Health +12% y/y on new products (Zenrelia, AdTab) and higher parasiticide sales, Farm Animal +18% y/y led by Rumensin cattle sales and global poultry strength. Gross margin held flat at 57.3% as higher revenue was offset by product mix and inventory costs. Interest expense rose $17M (+43% y/y), mainly imputed interest on the Blackstone royalty-sale liability, while the effective tax rate jumped to 34.6% from a 12.2% benefit a year earlier — together outweighing operating gains and pulling net income and diluted EPS down y/y. Operating cash flow turned positive ($13M vs -$4M). Cash fell to $428M on continued debt paydown; long-term debt is down 15% y/y. No forward guidance appears in this 10-Q.

drivers.explanation: Revenue grew on volume, FX, and pricing across both segments, but net income fell y/y as higher interest expense and a swing to a positive effective tax rate outweighed operating gains.
Pet Health revenue +12% y/y driven by higher volumes led by new products Zenrelia and AdTab plus increased parasiticide sales to new retail customers.
Gross profit rose largely on the revenue increase; margin percentage held flat as product mix and higher inventory costs offset the scale benefit.
Y/y decline reflects $17M higher interest expense (imputed interest on the Blackstone royalty-sale liability) and the effective tax rate swinging to 34.6% from a 12.2% benefit a year earlier.
Swing to positive operating cash flow was driven by an increase in non-cash expenses relative to net income, partially offset by working-capital changes.
Lower capex reflects timing of spending on the Elwood, Kansas monoclonal antibody facility expansion and Fort Dodge and Huningue manufacturing projects.
